errors.evidence: The description omits the "Retrieval" component, which is present in the legend and as the top segment (very light blue) of each stacked bar.
The description states there are "three categories" but then correctly lists four, which is a self-contradiction. The chart has four categories on the x-axis.
The vertical axis is labeled "sec.", not "Avg. sec". "Avg." is a category on the horizontal axis.
Each bar is composed of four colored sections, corresponding to Search, Fetch, Extract, and Retrieval, not three.
